function.name: deliberate_brainstorm
function.description: Engage deep System-2 ideation, first-principles deconstruction, adversarial council debate, and Pareto trade-off synthesis before writing code.

goal.description: The architectural challenge, system design, or feature to deliberate upon.

mode.description: Deliberation mode. flash (10s check), council (balanced debate), deep-explore (full Tree-of-Thoughts).

context.description: Relevant codebase background, existing tech stack, or data volume constraints.

constraints.description: Hard engineering constraints (e.g., zero external dependencies, p99 < 5ms).

function.name: deliberate_red_team
function.description: Run an adversarial stress-test against a file or architecture to uncover failure modes, race conditions, memory leaks, security vulnerabilities, and missing invariants.

goal.description: What the code is attempting to accomplish or migrate.

filePath.description: Path to the target file being evaluated.

fileContent.description: The actual source code to red-team.
